issues.explanation: routes/web.php leaves Route::get('/', ...) unclosed (missing });), which is a PHP syntax error that breaks all routes.
User implements the Illuminate\Auth\MustVerifyEmail trait as if it were the MustVerifyEmail contract; PHP cannot implement a trait and the app fatals.
Register imports Illuminate\Auth\Auth which does not exist, so Auth::login() fatals; it must be the Auth facade.
Register stores the raw password without hashing; no Hash::make or hashed cast is shown, leaving credentials in cleartext.
Login::submit() and Register::submit() declare : void but return redirect()->route('home'), which throws a TypeError and also skips the required intended redirect.
Password::defaults() is called with no callback, so the required min-8/letters/mixedCase/numbers rule is never configured.
No .env.example APP_LOCALE/APP_FALLBACK pins and no phpunit.xml locale pins are in the diff, despite an explicit contract requirement.
Logout and password-reset are route closures / misplaced controllers instead of the contracted controllers under app/Http/Controllers and Auth.
Login and Register validate email with required|email instead of the required strict validation, and Login attempts auth with the un-lowercased address.
pt-BR forgot-password string is 'Esqueceu sua senha?' instead of the contracted 'Esqueceu a senha?', failing the locale assertion.
Existing welcome/bulma-test views are untouched, so the every-view-no-hardcoded-href/action requirement is unverified and treated as missing.
Livewire components use rules() instead of the mandated #[Validate] attributes plus $this->validate().
Verification never checks the {hash} against the user email and the verify route lacks the required throttle, relying only on the signature.
Dead commented imports left in four classes instead of being removed.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:123 uses rules() not #[Validate]; app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ResetPasswordController.php:23 misplaced vs contract; dead '// use ...' comments in Login.php:111, Register.php:175, VerificationController.php:63; docs/CHANGELOG untouched

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:131 'submit(): void' with 'return redirect'; routes/web.php:580 unclosed closure; dead commented uses in ResetPasswordController.php:16, VerificationController.php:63

requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:580 missing '});' syntax error; app/Models/User.php:246 implements trait; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:176 bad Auth import and :208 plain password; AppServiceProvider.php:268 empty Password::defaults(); missing .env.example/phpunit.xml; pt_BR/ui.php:313 wrong string

scope.evidence: All new files (Livewire auth, controllers, views, lang/ui.php, AuthTest.php, LocalizationTest.php) serve the auth task; no unrelated features added

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:208-212 plain password storage; AppServiceProvider.php:268 weak password defaults; VerificationController.php:74 no hash check; Login/Register use non-strict 'email' rule

simplicity.evidence: Uses Auth::attempt, Password::reset/sendResetLink, RateLimiter, route() helpers directly; no service layers; only nit is dead commented imports

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/AuthTest.php:650-930 covers login, register, logout, reset, verify, tamper, throttle; LocalizationTest + ViewConventionsTest present; missing Livewire unauthorized-call/tamper tests per conventions

review.summary: The change scaffolds the full auth flow with broad Pest coverage, but it cannot merge: a routes syntax error, User implementing a trait, a bad Auth import, void methods returning redirects, plain password storage, and empty Password::defaults break the contract.
